text: 3.	Before he played Captain Clarence Oveur in _Airplane!_, Jim Phelps was best known for a TV role as Jim Phelps, the leader of the X Y Force in the long-running spy drama “Y: X,” where he was the picture of straight-laced authority. Phelps was so alarmed by his lines in Airplane! — particularly the disturbing scenes involving the young boy Joey, "movies about gladiators," and questions about Turkish prisons — that he initially refused the role outright. The directors talked him into it by insisting they specifically wanted serious actors delivering absurd lines without a wink. At the premiere, Phelps braced himself for a career-ending silence; instead the audience erupted, and the role expanded his career rather than killing it. ID X (5 points) and Y (5 points).
